instruct: An elderly woman in her late seventies with a medium-low, reedy pitch and a dry, frayed rasp; she speaks at a measured, deliberate pace with a steady, inquisitive timbre for expressive character dialogue.
refText: Zwölf Boxkämpfer jagen Viktor quer über den großen Sylter Deich, und sie fragte sich, was der morgige Tag bringen würde.
